decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - Condition 17: 
The Council is satisfied that the proposed landscaping is acceptable and would preserve or enhance the character and appearance of the listed building and the Cavalry Barracks Conservation Area, and is in compliance with policies ENV-B.2.7 Alterations to Listed Buildings and Buildings of Local Townscape Character, ENV-B.1.1 (All New Development) and ENV-B.2.2 (Conservation Areas) of the Unitary Development Plan
Condition 18:
Reason:
The Council is satisfied that the proposed materials are acceptable and would preserve or enhance the character and appearance of the listed building and the Cavalry Barracks Conservation Area, and is in compliance with policies ENV-B.2.7 Alterations to Listed Buildings and Buildings of Local Townscape Character, ENV-B.1.1 (All New Development) and ENV-B.2.2 (Conservation Areas) of the Unitary Development Plan
Condition 21: 
Reason:
The Council is satisfied that the proposed schedules of restoration and replacement are acceptable and would preserve or enhance the character and appearance of the listed building and the Cavalry Barracks Conservation Area, and is in compliance with policies ENV-B.2.7 Alterations to Listed Buildings and Buildings of Local Townscape Character, ENV-B.1.1 (All New Development) and ENV-B.2.2 (Conservation Areas) of the Unitary Development Plan
description: Details of the proposed landscaping and boundary treatment required by condition 17, details of materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the works required by condition 18 and details of all features to be removed, moved, replaced or reinstated required by condition 21 of planning permission 00092/A/L11 dated 11/04/2011 for the internal creation of 81 bedrooms within the existing Grade II listed Hardinge Block.
